LanguageData.CommandPrisonCommonsToggleDescActive: Prisoners can freely enter this room if it shares a door with their cell or another prison commons they can access. They may hang out here.
LanguageData.CommandPrisonCommonsToggleDescInactive: This is a normal gather spot.
LanguageData.CommandPrisonCommonsToggleDescActiveAcce: Prisoners may enter this room through shared doors to use fixtures (e.g. toilets), but it is not a hangout — they will not treat it as a prison commons lounge.
LanguageData.CommandPrisonCommonsToggleDescInactiveAc: Prisoners cannot use this fixture room as prison commons access.
LanguageData.CommandPrisonCommonsToggleDescActiveJoy: Prisoners may use this recreation building. Colonists will not. Also marks the room as prison commons hangout.
LanguageData.CommandPrisonCommonsToggleDescInactiveJo: Normal recreation — colonists may use it (unless the room is already a prison commons). Prisoners will not treat this building as for them.
LanguageData.PrisonCommons_Settings_EnableLoggingTip: Writes hangout/vacate/recreation decisions to Player.log (HANGOUT, HANGOUT_FAIL, VACATE, RECREATE). Turn off when done.
